title: Daily interest rate
clause: Interest is calculated at approximately 0.1% per day based on lender pledges and market conditions.

title: No upfront fees
clause: The P2P platform does not charge borrowers any upfront or disbursement fees.

title: Escrow simulation
clause: For demonstration purposes, no real funds are moved. All transactions are simulated in escrow.
sourceHint: Demo only simulation no real funds

title: Pledge matching
clause: Multiple lenders pledge funds which are pooled and matched to borrower requests automatically.

title: Flexible terms
clause: P2P loans offer flexible terms from 5 to 45 days, with no prepayment penalty.
sourceHint: 5 to 45 days flexible no prepayment penalty

title: Late payment process
clause: Late payments trigger a grace period of 3 days before default procedures begin.
sourceHint: 3 day grace period late payment default

title: Escrow release policy
clause: Funds are released to lenders only after borrower confirmation, cooling-off period, and dispute check.
